properties.name: spring.datasource-fallback.url
properties.description: Fallback database connection URL (e.g., localhost MySQL)

properties.name: spring.datasource-fallback.hikari.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum number of connections in fallback datasource pool

properties.name: spring.datasource-fallback.hikari.minimum-idle
properties.description: Minimum idle connections in fallback datasource pool

properties.name: spring.datasource-fallback.hikari.connection-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for fallback datasource in milliseconds
